note: E18-R32, window space corrected in E18-R43 (ADR 0568). Rows are (15, 128) RAW log-mel windows -- NOT normalised -- and the 3-column softmax from strum_crnn_live_3c_settled.bin. Dart must match within 1e-3. The windows are raw because CrnnStrumNet.forward standardises internally with the mean/std it parses from the asset; the original fixture shipped ALREADY-NORMALISED rows, so the Dart forward standardised them a second time and no consumer could ever have passed. De-normalised from the shipped rows with the asset's own mean/std: the normalise -> de-normalise -> normalise round trip is exact to 2.4e-07 on the window and 1.8e-07 on the softmax, four orders inside the tolerance. Values are full float32 precision rather than rounded, so both sides consume literally identical input (the r143 rule).
